description: Literal / regex code search (git grep, basic regex) across a repo at a ref. The dependable way to find code on this host — works on every repo, indexed or not. Returns {owner, repo, ref, total, truncated, matches: [{file, line, text}]}. Omit `ref` for the default branch.

ref.description: Branch / tag / sha (default: the repo's default branch)

name: gluecron_search_code
